CURRENT REPORT Pursuant to Section 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934

KLX Energy Services Holdings, Inc.

Item 3.01 Notice of Delisting or Failure to Satisfy a Continued Listing Rule or Standard; Transfer of Listing.

On September 17, 2026, the Company notified The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC that the stockholder rights agreement would terminate on September 23, 2026, and that the preferred stock purchase rights would expire on that date. Nasdaq will file a Form 25 to remove the rights from listing.

Item 8.01 Other Events.

The Company’s common stock continues to be listed on Nasdaq and is not affected by the expiration of the rights.
